result.name: DataExchange.Export.Run
result.description: Exports records with a Generic Export definition and writes the file to storage or returns it inline.
result.selectionDescription: Runs a Generic Export definition over a table view or a list of record SystemIds and delivers the file; payment files use DataExchange.PaymentExport.Run.

examples.title: A request refused before any change

response.error: Data Exchange definition X160-MISSING was not found.
response.nextStep: Call DataExchange.Definition.List with direction Export and use the exact code of a Generic Export definition.
response.hint: For usage details, call the "Help.Implementation.Get" message type with subject "DataExchange.Export.Run". Always read the help before calling a message type.

examples.title: Refusal: required request data is missing

response.error: 3 problems in the request. Nothing was changed.

errors.expected: a JSON string of at most 20 characters
errors.nextStep: Send "dataExchDefCode" as a JSON string of at most 20 characters and retry.

errors.error: Name the records to export with tableId or tableName (and an optional tableView), or with recordIds.
errors.nextStep: Send tableId 18 with tableView WHERE(No.=FILTER(10000..30000)), for example, or a recordIds array of SystemIds.

errors.error: Choose where the file goes: storageCode with path or folderPath, or inline true.
errors.nextStep: Send storageCode (find it with Storage.Account.List), or inline true for a file of at most 1 MB.

response.hint: For usage details, call the "Help.Implementation.Get" message type with subject "DataExchange.Export.Run". Always read the help before calling a message type.

result.overview: Selects the records of the mapping source table with tableView or recordIds, runs the standard export steps of the definition (Export Mapping and the writer) and writes the file to storage (storageCode with path or folderPath) and/or returns it inline (at most 1 MB). The Data Exch. entry keeps the file.
